subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw define a session-owned multi-turn model lease contract for `/model --turns N`, and should that same contract also shape one-turn Gateway/chat model overrides?
rationale: The request adds public command/API/config and persisted model-routing semantics; automation should not choose turn counting, warning timing, auth-profile preservation, fallback interaction, or overlap with one-turn override work without maintainer intent.

options.title: Specify a unified lease contract
options.body: Define a maintainer-approved temporary model lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway fields against that single session-state contract.

options.title: Settle one-turn override first
options.body: Keep this issue open but use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100876 to settle request-local override semantics before adding multi-turn leases.

options.title: Decline native leases
options.body: Do not add native turn leases and document manual `/model default`, allowlists, or operational policy as the supported cost-governance path.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified lease contract
recommendation.body: Define a maintainer-approved temporary model lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway fields against that single session-state contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on the existing session model override, Gateway patch, and docs paths that would own the lease contract.
